query: INSERT INTO checkout_handoffs(digest,tenant,cart_id,expires_at,recovery_digest,recovery_origin,recovery_expires_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,now()+interval '10 minutes',$4::text,$5,CASE WHEN $4::text IS NOT NULL THEN now()+interval '24 hours' END) ON CONFLICT(cart_id) DO UPDATE SET digest=EXCLUDED.digest,expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at,recovery_digest=EXCLUDED.recovery_digest,recovery_origin=EXCLUDED.recovery_origin,recovery_expires_at=EXCLUDED.recovery_expires_at,consumed_at=NULL
